asset.description: the machine the event is about; the shelf's only required coordinate

coordinate_datum.description: the horizontal frame/realisation and epoch the lat/lng pair is expressed in (expected: GNSS native, WGS 84 ensemble EPSG:4326)

coordinate_precision_class.description: whether the position is full precision or a reduced/precision-limited state

device.description: the telematics unit that produced the event, distinct from the asset identity

event_type.description: the discriminator that tells an ignition event from a speed or geofence crossing

financial_period.description: the accounting period the event falls in; derived, no raw source field

geographic_area.description: the resolved geofence/area the asset was located at

latitude.description: GNSS-native latitude from the raw `GPS` block

longitude.description: GNSS-native longitude from the raw `GPS` block

occurred_at.description: when the event happened; the temporal coordinate

operator.description: the driver/operator active on the machine

place_label.description: the human-readable location delivered by the source

source_system.description: which bound system emitted the row

trip.description: the source trip/journey grouping the event belongs to
